jericho.caveat: Annual shares only. Its hourly series cannot be used: carriers are a fixed scalar times one shared profile, so their correlation is 1.000000 and the composition is identical across all 38 regions to 4e-8 while regional scale varies 17.9x.
jericho.citation: Priesmann J, Nolting L, Kockel C, Praktiknjo A. Time series of useful energy consumption patterns for energy system modeling (JERICHO-E-usage). Scientific Data 8:148, 2021. doi:10.1038/s41597-021-00907-w
jericho.kind: useful energy by carrier, annual totals

rehfeldt.caveat: Digitised from Fig. 16 to about +-5 percentage points. Its own two datasets disagree by more than the subsectors differ from one another, so this is reported as a range and never as a point.
rehfeldt.citation: Rehfeldt M, Fleiter T, Toro F. A bottom-up estimation of the heating and cooling demand in European industry. Energy Efficiency 11:1057-1082, 2018. doi:10.1007/s12053-017-9571-y
rehfeldt.kind: heat by temperature band and cooling, shares of subsector demand
rehfeldt.scope: UK industry, 7 subsectors, two datasets (ECUK and FORECAST)

tno.caveat: No electricity and essentially no refrigeration. Its waste heat is rejected above ambient and is a heat pump source, not a cooling demand.
tno.citation: Marina A, Spoelstra S, Zondag HA, Wemmers AK. An estimation of the European industrial heat pump market potential. Renewable and Sustainable Energy Reviews 139:110545, 2021. doi:10.1016/j.rser.2020.110545
tno.kind: process and waste heat quantities with stream temperatures
